mapper.insert: insert into workplace(workplace_id, workplace_name, workplace_president_nm, workplace_no, workplace_cond, workplace_item, workplace_tel, workplace_fax, workplace_addr, workplace_manname, workplace_manemail, workplace_mantel) VALUES (#{workplace_id}, #{workplace_name}, #{workplace_president_nm}, #{workplace_no}, #{workplace_cond}, #{workplace_item}, #{workplace_tel}, #{workplace_fax}, #{workplace_addr}, #{workplace_manname}, #{workplace_manemail}, #{workplace_mantel})
mapper.select: select workplace_id, workplace_name, workplace_president_nm, workplace_cond, workplace_item, workplace_tel, workplace_fax, workplace_addr, workplace_manname, workplace_manemail, workplace_mantel from workplace where workplace_id=#{workplace_id}
